preparedBy: window_movie evidence analyst; no GUI operations during review

method.environment: Isolated macOS 27.2 ARM64 graphical virtual machine; actual AppKit and WindowServer surfaces
method.input: Dedicated virtual mouse events operated the actual Sparkle Install Update and Install and Relaunch controls; not direct updater-method calls
method.feed: Private loopback signed Appcast, not the public stable feed
method.signing: Official Sparkle 2.10.1 tools, existing com.riftlet.app.stable Keychain account; official and independent Ed25519 verification passed; no exported key

from.origin: Original website-download bundle retained from prior Finder installation and restaged in the owned isolated installation path

actualSteps.step: Original 1.0.1 checks private signed feed and shows version 1.0.2 plus notes
Install Update downloads the exact final DMG and reaches Ready to Install
Install and Relaunch replaces the isolated installation and starts the exact final 1.0.2 executable
Post-update logical data and existing file hashes equal pre-update state
System Screenshot.app Capture creates one new image; normal collector and edge thumbnail show it
Actual history window opens and previews the new system image
Final App Chrome connection check reports Connected and macOS communication permission allowed
actualSteps.result: PASS; connection check only, no new attachment after final update

afterSystemCapture.newImageLater: pending; archived by existing automaticArchive policy; same UUID and original media identity

limits: This was a real Sparkle install through a private signed loopback feed; official public-feed and public-download deployment are separate checks.
The actual new release is universal, but this install test executed ARM64 only. Physical Intel, minimum macOS 13 and shared Applications elevation are not established here.
The retained original website 1.0.1 bundle was restaged; this run did not re-download 1.0.1 or repeat Finder installation.
No post-upgrade ChatGPT attachment was submitted. Earlier real attachment evidence is separately source-bound; the final connection check is narrower.
Existing QA records contain a real prior UNKNOWN and three START rows; no personal user data was used or modified.
WindowServer screenshots show the relevant native controls, although unrelated QA-system notification banners obscure part of the upper-right margin.
